title: Milestone 6: 16x16 tiled raster
description: Implement the 16x16 tile grid, tile metadata/counter/offset buffers, primitive-to-tile binning, overflow policy, tile raster kernel, deterministic opaque ordering, and performance comparison against the minimal raster path.
close_reason: Completed: tiled 16x16 binning/raster path with bounded overflow telemetry and headless validation

title: Milestone 7: Depth color and HiZ policy
description: Choose and implement the MVP depth representation and opaque-world ordering policy, add validation for order disagreements, tile depth bounds, HiZ rejection, and a packed 64-bit atomic prototype for later entity paths.
close_reason: Completed: fixed depth-key ordering, depth validation mode, tile depth bounds, early-out, and packed depth/payload prototype

title: Milestone 5: Minimal world raster
description: Render recognizable opaque world surfaces in nooutput: setup visible world polygons, raster indexed output, sample texture and lightmap atlases, apply colormap rules, add depth, and expose visual debug modes.
close_reason: Completed: validated recognizable e1m1 nooutput dump through QrustyQuake adapter

title: Milestone 3: Resource model
description: Define renderer resource handles and tables for textures, lightmaps, surfaces, and worlds; add atlas storage/builders, upload/update APIs, and capacity telemetry.
close_reason: Completed persistent texture, lightmap, world resource tables, linear atlas uploads, surface metadata, telemetry, and headless resource tests.

title: Milestone 8: Present mode
description: Add a replaceable present backend interface, factor or reuse DMA-BUF/X11 present code, keep nooutput as the default test path, resolve to present surfaces, and add a display-guarded smoke test.
close_reason: Completed: QR_OUTPUT_PRESENT callback backend with indexed-to-XRGB resolve and headless present smoke test

title: Milestone 2: GPU kernel package
description: Add renderer-owned GPU kernel sources, CMake helpers for supported AMDGPU targets, kernel selection/load inside qr_context, GPU indexed clear, indexed-to-XRGB resolve, GPU-dispatch nooutput tests, and readback after GPU completion.
close_reason: Completed renderer-owned GPU kernel package with clear and XRGB resolve kernels plus headless validation.

title: Remove hot path GPU allocations
description: Preallocate transient quake_raster draw buffers at context creation so frame/draw paths do not create or destroy GPU buffers.
close_reason: Completed: preallocated transient world triangle buffer and replaced hot-path GPU allocation with QR_ERROR_NO_SPACE capacity check

title: Milestone 1: Nooutput diagnostics
description: Add headless nooutput diagnostics: raw indexed dumps, resolved-output inspection, deterministic pattern tests, padded-stride readback tests, and undersized-buffer failure tests.
close_reason: Completed nooutput indexed dump, XRGB/PPM inspection, padded readback, and undersized-buffer validation.

title: Milestone 10: Entities
description: Add alias model resources and commands, alias triangle raster, sprites, particles, and packed-atomic or ordered-pass policies where world ordering no longer applies.
close_reason: Completed: alias model upload/draw, sprite draw, and particle draw paths reuse preallocated tiled triangle dispatch

title: Milestone 0: Finish renderer library skeleton
description: Complete the isolated C99 quake_raster skeleton: replace ad hoc calloc/free with renderer-owned allocation, add API versioning, structured error enum, and public API docs for ownership, threading, and frame lifetime.
close_reason: Completed API versioning, structured result codes, ownership/threading docs, and centralized host allocation helpers.

title: Milestone 4: QrustyQuake adapter layer
description: Add adapter code outside the renderer core to extract Quake textures, mip levels, surface metadata, lightmaps, and visible world surface commands while keeping the existing KFD/palette backend as fallback.
close_reason: Added QrustyQuake-side quake_raster adapter scaffold for resource extraction and visible world surface recording while preserving the existing KFD presentation fallback.

title: Milestone 11: Performance and validation
description: Add perf counters, deterministic timedemo/headless benchmark mode, image diff tooling, stress scenes, and a CI-friendly nooutput validation subset.
close_reason: Completed: perf counters, headless benchmark, image diff tool, stress/nooutput tests, and validation docs

title: Milestone 9: Classic surface types
description: Add classic Quake sky, water/turbulence, transparent/cutout handling, animated light styles, and dirty dynamic lightmap updates.
close_reason: Completed: sky, turbulence, cutout, and dirty lightmap update support with QrustyQuake adapter submission
